scope: Descriptive development check on two already-open months; not new validation

model.meaning: Bind exactsavedmodel metadata only; never callfit or recomputeR.

rule: c=R-P; if abs(c)<=0.100 Q=P; otherwise magnitude=abs(c)-0.100, signed by c, then Q=P+signed magnitude. Exact binary64 operation order.

definitions.gain: absoluteErrorP-absoluteErrorMethod; positive is better than P
definitions.pairedGain: absoluteErrorOldF-absoluteErrorQ; positive means attenuation helped relative to old F
definitions.denominators: All methods retain full common monthly N; group means use group count and contributions monthly N
definitions.gate: Same strict amplitude gate as old F; gateActive may be true while Q rounds to P
definitions.examples: First chronological matching row chosen retrospectively; no influence on prediction or candidate choice
definitions.rowContext: Every row binds sourceRowIndex to input raw SHA; complete histories/features repeated only for all active origins
definitions.invalidity: No row drops or rescue; invalid candidate blocks continuation; finite negative raw R remains scored and flagged even when Q is nonnegative
definitions.temperatureIntegrity: Frozen feature names/order checked; temperature features finite but archived rows lack temperatureHistory

developmentContinuation.rule: All rows candidate-valid and MAE_P-MAE_Q>1e-9 in BOTH months
developmentContinuation.meaning: Conservative development screen, not statistical significance, future validation or ecological benefit

limits: No fit, model-prediction recomputation, new observations, threshold scan, bootstrap or causal inference.
Finalized archived measurements do not establish real-time as-of-origin availability.
Published equal readings and decimal precision do not establish physical stability or sensor accuracy.
Original P/R/F and previous directional diagnostic evidence remain unchanged.
